domain: Whether a single act of individual ethical courage at the workplace actually strengthens or weakens the organization's moral culture as a whole
topic: Whether a single act of individual ethical courage at the workplace actually strengthens or weakens the organization's moral culture as a whole

source.title: I Fact-Checked Trump’s Anti-Woke Report on the American History Museum

movement.gist: A junior engineer at a pharmaceutical firm quietly alerts regulators to falsified safety data, an act universally praised as ethically exemplary. Thesis: her individual courage signals that the organization contains moral capacity. (LOCAL_CLAIM_ESTABLISHED)

Evidence layer: colleagues celebrate her action; the firm itself adopts her memo as evidence of robust self-correction; she becomes the company's proof of its own conscience. The narrative is seamless at the individual scale. (EVIDENCE_LAYER)

But zoom to the organizational scale: her courage was necessary only because routine oversight failed; the firm didn't stop falsification through design or culture—it required one person to break ranks. (SCALE_JUMP)

At scale, her act becomes an institutional exception that inoculates the firm against genuine reform. She is held up as proof the system works, while the systems that required her heroism remain untouched. The question is no longer 'was her act good?' but 'does this organization need acts of individual courage to function morally?'—which inverts the initial claim. However, the deeper tension—whether reform is possible at all in such structures—displaces the original one. (INVERSION_AT_SCALE + DISPLACEMENT)

poles: individual ethical courage strengthens organizational conscience
individual ethical courage isolates the actor and hardens institutional resistance
virtue visible at the individual scale becomes virtue at the institutional scale
visibility itself becomes the problem—the act gets absorbed as an exception rather than a model

tension_system.interaction: The secondary tension shows why scale-jumping fails: institutional systems don't inherit courage from individual actors; they metabolize it into narrative exemptions.

family_realization.note: Scale shift is crystalline: individual heroism reads as moral proof at close range; widened to institutional level, same act becomes symptom of systemic failure. Scope discipline flawless—every wrong option ignores the scale inversion.

ending_behavior.note: Final paragraph displaces the original tension (is she a hero?) onto a harder unresolved question (can structure that requires rescue ever reform?). Refusal suspended perfectly: 'the question her celebrated envelope quietly buried.' Slight dip because aperture isn't quite as unsettling as it could be.

voice_consistency.note: Institutional Anthropology voice sustained throughout: 'tribe reassures itself,' 'ritual requires a hero,' 'metabolized,' 'cosmology.' Concrete particular: the windowless lab, the envelope, the slide deck. Uneven polish: repetition and careful clauses, not uniformly epigrammatic. Avoids generic AI register entirely.

distractor_efficiency.note: Traps well-set: Q1(C) causal_inversion seduces by rewarding heroism; Q2(A) tests stance-reading precision; Q4(A) mirrors surface logic; Q5(A) is adjacent-plausible. Q3(B) requires causality parsing. One weaker trap in Q7(C) uses extremism rather than structural mimicry, but overall traps are passage-earned.

explanation_quality.note: Every elimination ties to specific passage locations: 'paragraph 4: exempts not reforms,' 'paragraph 3: stopped because person not system,' 'final sentence: displaces onto unresolved question.' No vague 'not mentioned' or 'too extreme' cop-outs. Mechanism names are precise.
